warnAgentsMdTooLarge: AGENTS.md is {size} KB but Codex only reads the first {limit} KB — the rest is ignored. Move long rules to Codex skills (codex_mode: skill) or raise project_doc_max_bytes in ~/.codex/config.toml.

warnCodexReadsClaudeMd: {config} lists CLAUDE.md in project_doc_fallback_filenames, so Codex may read Claude's instructions.
warnLinksNotIgnored: {dir} holds Devdy symlinks that git does not ignore. Committed, they point to a path on this machine and break for everyone else — add it to .gitignore or .git/info/exclude.
